claim_or_topic: Non-identifiability in title and problem statement
reason_or_action: Finite sample and algorithmic search weakness do not establish structural non-identifiability.

claim_or_topic: Pilot M3 MAE .0304 and 48% lower propagation trajectories than M2
reason_or_action: True in single-graph pilot; later Phase5 M3 FULL343 MAE .12189 and modified algorithm. Lead with both; do not generalize pilot.

claim_or_topic: Top1/Top3/Top14 represent 45/95.6/99.917% Gibbs mass
reason_or_action: Retained mass refers only to original pilot's 48^3 Gibbs support, not Phase5 V3b 343 support.

claim_or_topic: Weighting benefit Delta MAE -0.0100
reason_or_action: Within same frozen 14-member support, post-hoc matched ledger; not proof weighted multi-model advantage overall.

claim_or_topic: Multi-graph battery tests future generalization
reason_or_action: Phase5 completed; 12 eligible cells and P2 gate failure. Replace tense and include residual errors.

claim_or_topic: CAO o=(G,s,sigma,r) and tau=(I,M)
reason_or_action: Central abstractions stand; distinguish interface, integration method and experimentally changed query.

claim_or_topic: sigma_G(s)=Pr[f_G(A,H)>=rho] described as survival
reason_or_action: It is horizon-specific cumulative-SLA-satisfaction probability, not first-violation survival; may not be monotone in H.

claim_or_topic: Research questions and four contributions framed solely as pilot
reason_or_action: B1 documents research stages and what they did/not establish, not a proof that a successful estimator emerged.

claim_or_topic: Novelty positioning of inverse ambiguity and uncertainty sets
reason_or_action: Useful citations, but avoid claiming full novelty or comprehensive literature coverage without separate updated review.

claim_or_topic: Point-estimate decision rule Eq4
reason_or_action: Correct as a defined decision rule, not a demonstrated reliable admission guarantee.

claim_or_topic: MC lower band is largest assurance threshold
reason_or_action: MC-only interval gives numerical estimation precision conditional on model; does not assure hidden-service SLA.

claim_or_topic: Completed or missed-deadline requests decided; zero decided => compliance 1
reason_or_action: Essential canonical estimand; verify event-ledger implementation and distinguish unresolved requests. Do not conflate with first passage.

claim_or_topic: Alternative I1-compatible provider processes interpreted as non-identifiability
reason_or_action: Finite optimizer candidate discrepancies imply practical ambiguity; formal equivalence/identifiability requires defined population, tolerance, mapping.

claim_or_topic: M3 = 48/provider and Top14
reason_or_action: Pilot only. Phase5 V3b uses 7/provider all 343 joint models; separate method variants explicitly.

claim_or_topic: Minimum and maximum model envelopes Eq5
reason_or_action: Finite propagated-model ranges are not confidence or credible intervals and do not cover arbitrary compatible models.

claim_or_topic: I1 local admissibility region construction and surfaces
reason_or_action: Check rho_region versus rho_query separation, disjoint acquisition seed banks, nestedness and fixed-quality pilot.

claim_or_topic: One graph and gamma-scaled SLA test battery
reason_or_action: This is Phase4 pilot-specific; Phase5 has four ASTs and new Step0 queries; P2 induced-region uses unscaled public composition.

claim_or_topic: Known fixed boundary terms 0.014003 and 0.03
reason_or_action: Historical ParAll numerical constants are implementation/version-specific; do not transfer to sequence variants.

claim_or_topic: Pilot prospective claim
reason_or_action: M3 conceived after earlier M2 results on same world. Fresh WB is prospective same-condition replication, not external validation.

claim_or_topic: M0 product Eq7
reason_or_action: Not SLA bound/certificate. Record conditional applicability; M0 9/15 pilot, 1776/6660 Phase5 points.

claim_or_topic: M1 TPE 100, N25 search, N100 confirm/replay
reason_or_action: Original frozen M1-v2 only; V3/V3b Phase5 replaced with 7×25 independent fits and N100 rescore.

claim_or_topic: 27 equal-weight members
reason_or_action: Same count can hide different provider search/selection procedures; Phase6 uses 256-search Sobol/TPE, top3 each.

claim_or_topic: Gibbs KL 48/provider, lambda30, product support
reason_or_action: Weights are loss-based heuristics, not calibrated posterior probabilities; 48^3 pilot differs from 7^3 V3b.

claim_or_topic: Support truncation bound Eq12
reason_or_action: Mathematically conditional on finite Gibbs mixture. Not truth error or guarantee of SLA; zero truncation in Phase5 FULL343.

claim_or_topic: 99.917% mass sufficient stopping rule
reason_or_action: Valid pilot conditional mixture approximation only. Phase5 Top14 retained as little as 55.2% (P1) pregraph, triggering FULL343 revision.

claim_or_topic: Comparative local vs graph simulation costs
reason_or_action: Distinguish once-per-provider reconstruction, recurring graph trajectories, unmatched budgets, and omitted implementation overhead.

claim_or_topic: Pilot ranked error curves, M3 near WB
reason_or_action: Numerically verified pilot; must be labeled as one physical graph not current cross-world main finding.

claim_or_topic: Top1/Top3/Top14 native-budget vs B1400 matched tests
reason_or_action: Keep equal-per-member vs matched-total-budget controls distinct. No causal conclusion that more models necessary.

claim_or_topic: M3 optimism small in all pilot regimes
reason_or_action: Signed bias relative to finite N200 WB; Phase5 persistent Mid/Stress errors and non-universal topology directions.

claim_or_topic: Hidden truth not recovered yet pilot graph predictions accurate
reason_or_action: Evidence for within-pilot existence; later P2 truth-fitting audit shows search failure despite truth fitting I1 better.

claim_or_topic: Top1 vs M1 attributed to candidate coverage
reason_or_action: Candidate generation and scoring both differ; no clean attribution to one mechanism.

claim_or_topic: Topology masking hypothesis to be tested prospectively
reason_or_action: The Phase5 registered Seq-vs-Par contrast has opposite signs in P1 vs P3/P4, and Delta_het cannot be evaluated (P2 gate).

claim_or_topic: RQ1 answer: under I1, accurate graph prediction yes
reason_or_action: Must become scope-dependent: promising pilot, aggregate relative improvement, substantial nontrivial errors in broad battery.

claim_or_topic: Narrow MC bands support certifiable composition depth
reason_or_action: Neither MC-only interval nor model spread certifies true hidden SLA; recursive composition depth untested.

claim_or_topic: Validity largely focused on single graph and finite N200 WB
reason_or_action: Add Step0 P2 missingness, search/fit limitations, simulator family, disclosure assumptions, developments informed by results.

claim_or_topic: Concludes M3 efficient and dependable based on pilot
reason_or_action: B1 summary must reflect all completed stages and documented limits, including failed generality.

claim_or_topic: MC variance, reconstructed-model spread, WB noise decomposition
reason_or_action: Useful distinct estimands; note idealized independence/unbiasedness and that plug-in noise-adjusted error is diagnostic not certifiable.

claim_or_topic: Refers to MC-width column of Table2
reason_or_action: Concrete internal cross-reference error: Table2 as printed has no MC-width column.

claim_or_topic: Latent spread can calibrate prediction error
reason_or_action: Exploratory question, not established; cannot use as deployed truth-error estimator without external calibration.

claim_or_topic: M1 is on reported nondominated recurring-cost frontier
reason_or_action: Table2 reports Top1 at B100 with MAE .0399 vs M1 B100 MAE .1852; within included operating points M1 is dominated. Fig2 frontier only applies to selected subset.

claim_or_topic: Pointwise numerical 95% bands and B^-1/2 projected width
reason_or_action: Conditional on frozen models and sampling design, not simultaneous calibration or global prediction uncertainty.

claim_or_topic: When MC band excludes beta, decision resolved
reason_or_action: Resolved only w.r.t. finite numerical MC approximation conditional on fitted model, not reliable admission of true graph.

claim_or_topic: Future tense about multi-graph and unsupported operational conclusion
reason_or_action: Maintain full chronology and evidence status; no blanket search-and-replace M3 as method variants are different.

claim_or_topic: Missing later information interfaces I2a/I2b and diagnostics
reason_or_action: Include matched P4/G_SEQPAR six-way study, P2 public induced region and fit/sensitivity audit as separate development/retrospective tracks.

claim_or_topic: Simulation upgrades and experiment infrastructure
reason_or_action: Document graph AST, native queue/branch dependencies, reproducibility and engineering smoke ordering deviation before claims of simulator novelty.

claim_or_topic: M3 worst-case variance plugged into normal 95% interval
reason_or_action: Conservative variance does not guarantee nominal normal coverage with unequal or tiny member N; present as approximate, pointwise and conditional.

claim_or_topic: Checking interval repeatedly and stopping when beta separates
reason_or_action: Standard fixed-N Wilson/bootstrap/normal bands are not always-valid under optional stopping; numerical resolution not certification or deterministic stability.

claim_or_topic: Across-method and across-query dependence
reason_or_action: M2 paired CRN preserves within-seed correlation; M3 nested prefixes reuse rank ledgers; Phase5 WB bootstrap reuses seed multiplicity across 12 cells. 6660 outcomes are not independent.

claim_or_topic: MC-subtracted model spread and WB discrepancy
reason_or_action: A4 and A7 are expectation identities given fixed unbiased estimators; nonnegative plug-in and square-root errors are noisy/clipped, not guaranteed model-error estimates.

claim_or_topic: Within-bank truncation and finite-B numerical error
reason_or_action: Pilot Top14 mass loss and Phase5 FULL343 zero truncation are internal Gibbs-support properties; no physical truth bound follows.

claim_or_topic: Prospective M3 result and operational Top1 Top3 readouts listed together
reason_or_action: Prospectively frozen production M3 and retrospectively evaluated support readouts have different evidential status and simulation histories; annotate role and method version.

claim_or_topic: M0 MAE and beta decision agreement denominators
reason_or_action: M0 applies to 9/15 queries and 274 WB-reference-certain points; M1/M2/M3 are assessed over 15/15 and 481 such points at beta 0.90. Scores are not same-population.

claim_or_topic: Claim that Top1 Top3 operational readouts used no new simulation
reason_or_action: Reading frozen Stage-B ledgers costs no new simulator execution at readout time but Stage-B generated a separate postpilot simulation bank; do not imply availability before prospectively frozen pilot.

claim_or_topic: Matched-budget Top1 Top3 curves compared with Table 2 operational rows
reason_or_action: Figure 1 Top1 Top3 are matched B1400 posthoc support diagnostics, whereas Table 2 operational Top1 and Top3 use B100 and B300. Do not mix their error or precision conclusions.

claim_or_topic: Recurring-only Pareto diagram omits upfront provider fitting
reason_or_action: Restricted pilot x axis is graph trajectories only; M3 Top1 has greater local construction cost than M1, and cannot be called globally cost-dominant. Keep selection restriction in caption.

claim_or_topic: Hidden truth and M1 Top1 parameter triplets and public I1 losses
reason_or_action: Retrospective sources exist but were not rowwise verified from the saved Table4 inputs by the B1 Step1 numerical audits; check original parameter and loss tables before copying.

claim_or_topic: Width proportional to B^-1/2 and budget inversion
reason_or_action: Anchor arithmetic is consistent but extrapolations assume frozen support allocations and design; numerical interval width is not predictive MAE or SLA decision assurance.

claim_or_topic: Per-regime row counts and signs
reason_or_action: Each regime covers 185 correlated horizon-query points based on shared white-box bank; printed regime means agree with whole-battery MAE at rounding precision but must not be treated as independent scenario replicates.

claim_or_topic: Production allocation versus equal allocation interpreted causally
reason_or_action: Production weighted14 and equal-allocation weighted14 use different seed banks and allocations; their difference is descriptive. The identical-ledger weighted-versus-uniform control isolates weighting.
